question: A classroom investigation uses the vectors $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}$, $\vec{b}=\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ and $\vec{c}=2\hat{i}-\hat{k}$. The students examine the vector product of $\vec{a}$ with the sum $\vec{b}+\vec{c}$ and compare it with the sum of the two separate vector products $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ and $\vec{a}\times\vec{c}$. They then interpret the magnitude of the resulting cross product geometrically as an area.(a) Calculate $\vec{b}+\vec{c}$.(b) Evaluate $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ and $\vec{a}\times\vec{c}$.(c) Verify the distributive relation $\vec{a}\times(\vec{b}+\vec{c})=\vec{a}\times\vec{b}+\vec{a}\times\vec{c}$.(d) Determine the area of the parallelogram having $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}+\vec{c}$ as adjacent sides.
explanation: (a)`\vec{b}+\vec{c}=(\hat{j}+\hat{k})+(2\hat{i}-\hat{k})\vec{b}+\vec{c}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}`(b)\\vec{a}\\times\\vec{b}=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\1 & 2 & 0\\\\0 & 1 & 1\\end{vmatrix}`\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}`Also,\\vec{a}\\times\\vec{c}=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\1 & 2 & 0\\\\2 & 0 & -1\\end{vmatrix}`\vec{a}\times\vec{c}=-2\hat{i}+\hat{j}-4\hat{k}`(c)\\vec{a}\\times(\\vec{b}+\\vec{c})=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\1 & 2 & 0\\\\2 & 1 & 0\\end{vmatrix}`\vec{a}\times(\vec{b}+\vec{c})=-3\hat{k}`On the other hand,`\vec{a}\times\vec{b}+\vec{a}\times\vec{c}=(2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k})+(-2\hat{i}+\hat{j}-4\hat{k})\vec{a}\times\vec{b}+\vec{a}\times\vec{c}=-3\hat{k}`Hence, the distributive relation is verified.(d)The area of the parallelogram is`|\vec{a}\times(\vec{b}+\vec{c})|=|-3\hat{k}|=3`Therefore, the required area is $3$ square units.

options.C:
(a) $\vec{b}+\vec{c}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}$
(b) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, $\vec{a}\times\vec{c}=-2\hat{i}+\hat{j}-4\hat{k}$
(c) Both sides of the distributive relation equal $-3\hat{k}$
(d) Area $=3$ square units
options.D:
(a) $\vec{b}+\vec{c}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$
(b) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, $\vec{a}\times\vec{c}=-2\hat{i}+\hat{j}-4\hat{k}$
(c) The distributive relation does not hold
(d) Area $=\sqrt{13}$ square units
